name: Daily Time Keeper Splash Screen Animation

stages.label: Initializing workspace...
stages.effect: Motion scale from 0.8 to 1.0, y-axis glide, radial background glow

stages.label: Loading local time logs & cache...
stages.effect: Indigo gradient progress fill, pulsing outer glow halo

stages.label: Connecting cloud synchronization...
stages.effect: Sparkle badge counter-rotation, cloud connection handshake

stages.label: Ready
stages.effect: Emerald checkmark badge transition, full progress bar completion

stages.label: App Mounted
stages.effect: Smooth scale 1.02, opacity fade out exit transition

palette.radialGradient: from indigo-950/60 via slate-950 to black
